description: This Python source file defines classes and functions for integrating Weave with OpenTelemetry for observability and monitoring of LLM operations. It includes configuration retrieval, span attribute setting, and a custom OpenTelemetry logger tailored for Weave's environment. Key components involve setting span attributes, managing headers, and controlling span lifecycle behavior for Weave-specific telemetry tracking.
